name: calm
note: The default for text-led films: soft natural touches, one tuned voice for bells and text, gentle air for moves, a single struck note for the lockup. Clicks, ticks, the pop, the snap, the space bar and the short whoosh are CC0 recordings fitted as code, where they measure closer to their role than the forge member (earshot match against the role's description and against synth-blip descriptions, earshot realness); the other touches are forge taps, the tuned voice is the launch film's measured kalimba. Every take passes the model-free audit (earshot kit check). Riser, swell, suck and drop are off: a reveal resolves on one element. Drum-free edition: kick, thump and sub-drop members replaced by clean equivalents (motion-graphics plugin 1.4).

tick.note: domino pieces knocking, a CC0 recording fitted as code (0.14 s): matches 'a soft quiet UI tick' at z +1.02, p 0.67 over synth-blip descriptions (tap/glass: -0.08, p 0.01), realness 0.83 (0.45); level +3 dB for its lower loudness at the same peak

hit.note: the lockup as one struck bell (C5 until edits.pitch or a retune moves it) (single attack, no build, 1.9 s natural decay): a soft tonal resolve instead of a boom; set edits.pitch to the film's root

pop.note: a soft mouth plop, a CC0 recording fitted as code (0.28 s), no pitch glide: matches 'a soft natural pop' at z +2.98, p 1.00 over synth-blip descriptions (pro_pop_in/airy: +1.88, 0.98), realness 0.97 (0.65)

whoosh.short.note: a short whoosh, a CC0 recording fitted as code (0.48 s, one smooth pass): matches 'a short fast whoosh swish through the air' at z +5.32 (swipe/velvet, which reads as 'a heavy thud': +2.01), realness 0.99 (0.97)

key.note: a thocky mechanical key, a new take per keystroke; the light / laptop members ring (comb ring in the audit)

click.note: a small plastic click, a CC0 recording fitted as code (0.13 s, 4.9 kHz centroid): matches 'a soft UI button click' at z +1.70, p 0.73 over synth-blip descriptions (tap/finger, which reads as 'a punchy impact hit': +1.37, 0.61), realness 0.97 (0.89)

click.confirm.note: a soft tuned pluck confirms: the same voice as bell and text, quieter

snap.note: a switch flip, a CC0 recording fitted as code (0.19 s, one attack): matches 'a toggle switch click' at z +2.24, p 1.00 over synth-blip descriptions (pro_pop_in/knock: +0.61, 0.27), realness 0.97 (0.08)

bell.note: the launch film's kalimba on two octaves of the key's pentatonic (C: G4-E6, 10 notes, until a retune moves it): one tuned note per progress step or motif note, so a climbing motif has a rung for every step

text.note: one soft tuned note when a text fragment resolves (not per word), stepping through the chord's tones among the five pentatonic degrees of one octave, under the picture

off.suck: off by default: a reverse whoosh into a cut stacks a build onto the reveal
off.riser: off by default: a reveal resolves on one element; add pro_riser/air_gate only if the treatment needs a build
off.drop: a calm film resolves without a sub drop; pro_sub_drop/soft tuned to the root is the restrained choice if weight is needed
off.swell: off by default: a reverse swell before a hit is a stacked lead-in
